meaning:
ἐξοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐξέχω, to stand out), [in LXX for שֵׁן, Job.39:28 * ;]
1. a projection (ἐ. πέτρας, Job.39:28).
2. Metaphorical, eminence, excellence: οἱ κατ᾽ ἐ., the chief men, Act.25:23.†
(AS)
